title: Antenuptial Contract (ANC) Drafting & Registration
subtitle: Drafting ANC agreements with or without accrual prior to marriage
author: Bouul Legal Team
problemHeadline: Marrying in community of property makes you 100% liable for your partner's debts
problemBody: Failing to register an ANC at the Deeds Office before your wedding date invalidates the agreement.
bouulSolution: Admitted Notary Public drafts customized ANC with or without the accrual system
Formal notarization signing session prior to wedding date and Deeds Office registration
Escrow released after Deeds Office ANC registration certificate is issued
aiPromptExample: Book ANC notary: 'Draft ANC with accrual system before wedding in Johannesburg.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: Consult + ANC Drafting + Notarization + Deeds Office Registration. Escrow: R3,200.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after Deeds Office ANC registration certificate is delivered.
pirbStandard: LPC Admitted Notary Public & Deeds Office Registered.

articleSections.heading: Accrual System Customization
articleSections.body: Spouses declare initial net asset values to ensure fair financial sharing upon dissolution.

articleSections.heading: Pre-Wedding Registration
articleSections.body: Notaries execute the ANC before the marriage ceremony and lodge it at the Deeds Office within 3 months.

title: Apostille Certificate & DIRCO Document Legalization
subtitle: Legalizing South African public documents for international use under the Hague Convention
author: Bouul Legal Team
problemHeadline: Foreign governments reject South African birth certificates or degrees without an Apostille
problemBody: Navigating DIRCO and High Court Apostille processes independently takes weeks of frustration.
bouulSolution: Notary Public authenticates copies and submits documents for High Court or DIRCO Apostille seals
Apostille certification of degrees, police clearances, birth certificates, and power of attorney
Escrow released upon delivery of official Apostille-stamped documents
aiPromptExample: Book Apostille: 'Obtain High Court Apostille for degree certificate for UK visa application.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: Notarial copy authentication + High Court Apostille Certificate. Escrow: R1,500.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released upon delivery of Apostille-stamped document.
pirbStandard: LPC Admitted Notary Public & High Court Registered.

articleSections.heading: Hague Convention Compliance
articleSections.body: Apostille certificates grant international legal recognition across 120+ Hague member countries.

articleSections.heading: DIRCO Fast-Tracking
articleSections.body: Notaries utilize specialized courier channels to process DIRCO embassy legalizations efficiently.

title: Notarial Bond Registration over Movable Property
subtitle: Securing commercial loans using business equipment, vehicles, or inventory as collateral
author: Bouul Legal Team
problemHeadline: Banks require formal security over movable assets before granting business loans
problemBody: Unregistered security pledges fail to grant preference over other creditors in insolvency.
bouulSolution: Notary Public drafts General or Special Notarial Bonds over specified business equipment
Registration of the bond at the Deeds Office to create legal security for lenders
Escrow released upon Deeds Office bond registration certificate delivery
aiPromptExample: Quote Notarial Bond: 'Register Special Notarial Bond over 4 business vehicles for R800k loan.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: Draft Bond + Asset Schedule + Deeds Office Lodgement. Escrow: R6,500.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released upon Deeds Office registration confirmation.
pirbStandard: LPC Admitted Notary & Security Registration Specialist.

articleSections.heading: Special vs General Bonds
articleSections.body: Special Notarial Bonds hypothecate specific identified movables (with serial numbers) creating real security.

articleSections.heading: Creditor Preference
articleSections.body: Registered bonds grant the lender preferred creditor status under SA insolvency law.

title: Notarial Servitude & Rights of Way Registration
subtitle: Registering praedial or personal servitudes (pipes, access roads, power lines) on title deeds
author: Bouul Legal Team
problemHeadline: Unregistered property access agreements are non-binding when land changes ownership
problemBody: Neighbors disputing driveway access or pipeline routes require formal registered servitudes.
bouulSolution: Notary Public drafts Servitude Agreements and registers them against property title deeds
Includes Rights of Way, Pipeline Servitudes, and Power Line Cable Encroachments
Escrow released upon Deeds Office title deed endorsement
aiPromptExample: Quote servitude: 'Register right-of-way servitude across farm property boundary.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: Draft Servitude Deed + Attach Surveyor Diagram + Deeds Office Lodgement. Escrow: R8,500.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after Title Deed endorsement by Registrar of Deeds.

articleSections.heading: Binding on Successors in Title
articleSections.body: Registered servitudes bind all future buyers of the property, ensuring permanent legal access.

articleSections.heading: Surveyor Diagram Attachment
articleSections.body: Servitude areas are precisely defined by SG (Survevor-General) approved diagrams.

title: Long-Term Lease Registration (10+ Years)
subtitle: Drafting and registering long-term property leases at the Deeds Office
author: Bouul Legal Team
problemHeadline: Leases longer than 10 years are not enforceable against new buyers unless registered
problemBody: Commercial tenants investing millions in building fit-outs risk eviction if property is sold.
bouulSolution: Notary Public notarizes long-term lease agreements and registers them against the title deed
Protects tenant tenure rights for 10 to 99 year commercial or agricultural leases
Escrow released upon Deeds Office registration certificate delivery
aiPromptExample: Quote long lease: 'Notarize and register 15-year commercial lease for retail center tenant.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: Notarize 15-Year Lease + Deeds Office Registration. Escrow: R9,500.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after Title Deed registration endorsement.

articleSections.heading: Real Right Protection
articleSections.body: Registration elevates a contractual lease into a 'real right' enforceable against all third parties.

articleSections.heading: Tenant Investment Security
articleSections.body: Ensures anchor tenants can amortize multi-million Rand property upgrades with absolute security.

title: Retirement Village Life Rights Contract Notarization
subtitle: Notarizing Life Rights agreements for retirement village housing development
author: Bouul Legal Team
problemHeadline: Retirement village purchases require absolute legal clarity on Life Right occupancy terms
problemBody: Unclear refund terms upon death or relocation create distress for surviving family members.
bouulSolution: Notary Public reviews and notarizes Life Rights Agreements under the Housing Development Schemes for Retired Persons Act
Protects retiree occupancy rights and defines exact payback percentage formulas
Escrow released upon delivery of executed Notarial Life Right contract
partsNeeded: Housing Development Schemes for Retired Persons Act checklist
aiPromptExample: Book Life Rights notary: 'Review and notarize Life Right contract for retirement village unit.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: Contract Legal Audit + Notarization Session + Execution. Escrow: R3,500.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after delivery of notarized agreement.

articleSections.heading: Statutory Protection
articleSections.body: Life Rights contracts comply strictly with Act 65 of 1988, securing lifelong housing rights.

articleSections.heading: Refund Transparency
articleSections.body: Ensures clear contractual terms for capital refund percentages to estate beneficiaries.
